revision_scope: Structured-record reconciliation, source acquisition audits and bounded reproducible analyses of already identified Mars/Earth evidence.
delivery_record_state: Current package records and numerical checks are reviewable. Completion of the full scientific objective is unproven.
publication_state: GitHub commit/PR publication must be verified separately by remote readback; this status file alone makes no upload claim.

integrity_qa.earth_checks: Separate current manifest/source/calculation/export integrity assertions; see earth/verification.json. Not added to the named-check count.
integrity_qa.scope: Record integrity and numerical reproduction only; no substitution for independent observations.
integrity_qa.additional_catalogue_check: Daubar2022 original workbook:1203 finite impact-coordinate rows; zero points in inclusive MS-02 bounds. Source headers/coordinate conventions and hashes audited; no ice-absence inference. See audit/catalogue_roi_check.json. Not included in 362 named package checks.

formal_report.status: Preserved byte-for-byte for the human author. It retains historical statements superseded by current structured records and follow-up notes; do not treat its old prose as the current evidence-state authority.

current_evidence_authority: the current six package notes, source logs, data tables and verifiers
local_validation/research_notes.md and corrected root CSVs within their stated scopes
unresolved_scientific_requirements: MS-02 still lacks colocated independent evidence establishing ice presence, the true interface depth, and ice amount. The released depth 0.4499824941 m is a conditional thermal-model value; no ice-absence inference is licensed.

CRISM material identification remains open: the original 55 detector-row numbers, exact WA calibration CDR450924300802_WA0300010L_3.IMG, scene sample/line linkage, validated band/pixel quality and atmospheric/thermal/photometric treatment have not been recovered and applied.

CTX catalogue repeat geometry has been quantified, but radiometric calibration, SPICE camera projection, validated orthorectification/registration, usable-pixel masks, fine-scale terrain and repeat-change uncertainty remain unavailable. Nominal footprint coverage does not establish actual morphology or change.

Pathare2018 supplemental Table S1 N16 numerical WEH/layer-depth values and their applicable uncertainty have not been acquired for MS-02. MONS coarse hydrogen support is not an independent 0.5-degree ice measurement.

Thermal per-cell observation dates/counts, residuals, RMS and depth CI remain absent. The 2019 observation-bin to released-product processing chain is unverified. Published 2026 native-grid and equal-weight rules are known, but local BF08/SWIM23 components, masks, missing-data handling and exact release identity are not reconstructed; the combined value remains null.

Earth validation remains incomplete: original Beacon time series/calibration, Haughton radar/core numerical records, WISDOM polygon-line coordinates and colocated independent ice truth, and University Valley original logger/calibration/clock/deployment identity records and matched material/boundary controls remain missing. Reused author-calibrated UV exports are distinct from unprocessed logger records and do not supply those controls.

Actual MS-02 cover thickness/material and accumulation rate lack an independently validated local observation. Column dust optical depth cannot be converted to a deposition rate or cover thickness with the available data.
unknown_handling: Unknown numeric quantities remain blank/null with reasons; no probability, zero, fitted uncertainty, local truth or scientific completion is invented.
earth_update_policy: Consult the current earth/source_audit.csv, earth/uv_export_support.json and earth/verification.json for the final source/channel review. This consolidation intentionally does not freeze a snow-proxy event count or pending channel-review result.
out_of_scope_for_this_revision: Replacement of the human-authored formal report
Edits to other Mars sites, shared results or the website
New field experiments or contact with authors/recipients
completion_rule: A data/QA pass cannot close a requirement whose independent scientific evidence is missing. Every unresolved requirement above keeps the requested all-problems-resolved objective incomplete.
